Khalgrom is an Elegant Serif Font with Timeless Sophistication.

The Khalgrom font is a refined serif typeface that blends classic charm with a modern flair.

Featuring graceful curves, high contrast strokes, and carefully crafted alternates & ligatures, it adds a touch of luxury to any design.

Perfect for branding, editorial design, fashion headlines, and wedding invites—Khalgrom brings glamour and delicacy to every letterform.

The Khalgrom serif font is also PUA-encoded, ensuring effortless access to all glyphs, swashes, and alternate characters to help you customize your creations with ease.
